docs.title: Senior Member of Technical Staff | Software Development Engineer
docs.text: Welcome to my personal portfolio. I am a backend-focused Software Engineer with extensive experience in building scalable microservices, cloud infrastructure, and data processing systems at Oracle Cloud Infrastructure and Amazon.

docs.title: Summary
docs.text:
• Languages: Java, Go, Scala, SQL, C++
  • Key Skills: Microservices, Distributed Systems, Cloud Infrastructure (AWS & OCI), Big Data Processing.
  • Experience: Proven track record in modernizing legacy systems, optimizing high-volume data pipelines (accounting for billions of dollars), and designing robust RESTful APIs.

docs.title: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure
docs.text:
Senior Member of Technical Staff 08/2025 – Present

  • Modernized Subscription Provisioning: Designed and implemented Service Manager Proxy (SMP), a microservice system decoupling subscription management from billing, account, and identity systems.
    • Scaled and handled > 1K TPS.
    • Created APIs for synchronous and asynchronous request processing.
  • API Development: Designed and developed 10+ RESTful APIs using Dropwizard (Java) and WFAAS workflows for handling order subscriptions, billing, provisioning, updates, suspension, and termination for SaaS and IaaS customers.
  • Legacy Deprecation: Successfully deprecated the Admin partner portal, migrating to modern frameworks and cloud infra, resulting in an 80% decrease in response times.

docs.title: Amazon Development Center India
docs.text:
Software Development Engineer 2 10/2023 – 07/2025

  • Logistics Expense System: Designed and developed an end-to-end system for computing logistics expenses from vendors to Amazon Warehouses, accounting for $3.6 Billion Annually.
  • Profitability Enhancement: Enhanced accounting accuracy for expenses with no designated account using Heuristic methodologies.
    • Improved accuracy by 20%.
    • Automated $60 Million MoM.
    • Tech Stack: EMR, Apache Spark, Apache Hudi, AWS Step Functions, AWS EventBridge, CloudWatch.

Software Development Engineer 1 10/2021 – 10/2023

  • Configuration Management: Designed a system to orchestrate and maintain business-critical configurations.
    • Built using AWS pipelines, AppConfig, Pydantic, Lambda.
    • Reduced deployment time from 2 hrs to 5 mins.
    • Hosts > 200 configs.
  • Data Ingestion Framework: Developed a framework to ingest, validate, categorize, and transform data from various sources.
    • Enabled automation of allocation capabilities.
    • Onboarded 10 programs and automated $500 Million yearly.
  • Cost Allocation Algorithm: Developed a clustering algorithm using heuristic methods to allocate unaccounted costs ($1 Billion annually) using a weighted network over a configurable trailing period.
  • Automation: Implemented automation scripts and SOPs, reducing recurring tickets by 37%.
    • Tech Stack: Python, Lambda, EventBridge, Boto3.

docs.title: RideShare Application
docs.text:
Technologies: AWS, Python, Flask, SQLite, Docker, Zookeeper, RabbitMQ

  • Built a backend application mimicking popular cab-sharing services with high availability and fault tolerance.
  • Architecture: Leader-follower architecture with load balancing.
  • Rerouted reads to follower nodes for performance optimization.
  • Used SQLite for in-memory database requirements.
  • Completely hosted on AWS.

docs.title: Visualization of Graph Algorithms
docs.text:
Technologies: Python, JavaScript, Flask, Sigma JS

  • Developed a web application to visualize graph algorithms such as BFS, DFS, Dijkstra’s, etc.
  • Backend: Flask (Python).
  • Frontend: JavaScript with the Sigma JS library.
